data.title: 三司绫濑 · 不用维持的笑容
data.description: 咖啡馆的角落没有镜头，也没有等待回应的人。绫濑低头尝了一口饮料，听你说完笑话才抬起眼，露出一个很自然的笑。
data.action: smiling at her partner across a cafe table
data.promptProse: In a cozy, secluded corner of a quiet cafe, Ayase relaxes at a small wooden table, sharing a natural, genuine smile with her partner. Two steaming mugs sit between them, catching the soft afternoon light that filters through sheer window curtains, which cast a hazy, dreamlike glow on her soft features and the quaint, warm interior.
data.animaCaption: Her partner sits across the table outside the frame.
